claim: HLTViews declares a platform floor of .iOS(.v15) in its Package.swift manifest.
HLTChatServices declares a platform floor of .iOS(.v15) in its Package.swift manifest.
HLTFoundations declares a platform floor of .iOS(.v13) in its Package.swift manifest.

ServerAppSettings.BlockFlow is an enum with cases customBlock, invalidDevice, invalidOsVersion, invalidAppVersion, expiredKit, endOfLife, usedOrder, orderNotFound, expiredOrder and unauthorizedPatient.
PreLoginCoordinator.handleSuccess handles the blockFlow cases .customBlock and .invalidAppVersion and falls through to .fatalError for every other case.

LobbyViewModel.canStartFlow() calls handle(...), which maps .invalidDevice to the .validDevice alert, .invalidOsVersion to .validOS, .invalidAppVersion to .validApp (deep-linking to the App Store via AppURL.External.store(forAppId:)), and also handles .expiredKit, .endOfLife and .unauthorizedPatient.
DipioApp+ServiceConfigurator uses the bundle app version SemVer for logging.
DipioApp+ServiceConfigurator resets launchCount when the app version indicates an upgrade.
AboutPageFactory builds the About page version string from the bundle app version.
DipioApp reads the App Store id from Natrium.Config.appId and calls fatalError in a release build when it is still the default -1.
DebuggerDetection is compiled out of SecurityDetectionManager's detection list in DEBUG builds.
JailbrokenDeviceDetectionFactory is the app-side adapter supplying the Info.plist, canOpenURL and fileExists providers to the detection.
PreLoginCoordinator.start() runs the security detection first and, on a positive result, shows the .jailbrokenDevice block screen without proceeding.
NetworkManager owns an NWPathMonitor and exposes internetReachable.
LobbyViewModel picks between the .serverError and .noNetwork alerts based on network reachability.
LobbyViewModel.canStartFlow() refuses to start a test unless ServerAppSettings.state is .finished.
DipUtils.isBatteryCharged() passes when battery level is above 5 percent or state is .charging, toggling isBatteryMonitoringEnabled around each read.
LobbyViewModel enforces the battery check, producing .lowBattery and the .battery alert.
DipUtils.diskSpaceAvailable() reads attributesOfFileSystem(forPath: NSHomeDirectory()) and compares systemFreeSize in MB against AppConfiguration.current.lowDiskSpaceSize.
AppConfiguration+PersistedSettings declares the lowDiskSpaceSize threshold with a default of 80 MB.
AppConfiguration applies the server's lowDiskSpaceSize field as an override of the local threshold.
LobbyViewModel enforces the disk-space check, producing .lowDiskSpace and the .diskSpace alert.
HLTCaptureAuthorizationProvider wraps AVCaptureDevice.authorizationStatus and requestAccess as isAuthorized, didDenyAuthorization and requestAuthorization.
DipUtils.cameraPermissionNeeded() is the negative form of the camera authorization check.
TestCoordinator passes the current camera authorization state into the chat as an input condition and injects the authorization-request closure.
InstructionsChatViewModel turns the camera grant/deny outcome into a chat event or the .deniedVideoCaptureAuthorization alert.
LobbyViewModel evaluates, in order, blockSubsequentTest, recent results, recent failure, ServerAppSettings.state, battery, disk, then fatalError if orderId is nil.
AuthenticationCoordinator sequences Onboarding, then phone verification, then date of birth conditionally.
AppCoordinator shows authentication when Natrium.Config.withAuthentication is true and authenticationHelper.isAuthenticated is false.
AuthenticationHelper.trySetAsUnauthorized() holds the AuthenticationState transitions and re-entry rules.
AppCoordinator.setActiveChildCoordinator() wires the getter/setter tuples AuthenticationHelper uses for persistence.
AuthenticationHelper exposes verifyPhoneNumber, verifyPinCode, fetchAccessToken, verifyInviteCode and createPatient.
AuthenticationCoordinator emits the multiplePatientsSameDevice event and routes to date of birth when the OTP succeeds with state .additionalIdentificationRequired.
AppConfiguration sets the session-only DobVerification from the server's isDOBVerified field.
AppCoordinator drops the DOB verification when the app returns to the foreground.
FlowCoordinator drops the DOB verification after it has been used.
ServerAppSettings calls anonymousSignUp to mint a token and patientId for targets whose withAuthentication is false.
AppSettingsNetworkService.BaseURL.anonymousSignUp is the endpoint constant for the anonymous signup call.
HealthyServerConfigurationFields.Key has .authToken, .tempToken and .secureToken, all mapped to the Authorization header with the value "<tokenType> <token>".
AppConfiguration takes tokenType from Natrium.Config.tokenType and re-latches it every time a new token is stored.
AppConfiguration.token is the accessor for authToken and tempToken, which live in the encrypted AppSessionInfo file rather than UserDefaults.
AppConfiguration exposes phoneNumber, which lives in the encrypted UserInfo file.
AppSettingsNetworkService detects a 401 on the init call.
ServerAppSettings turns the init 401 into authenticationState = .failed.
DataManager propagates the failed authenticationState.
LobbyViewModel surfaces the failed authentication state as the .automaticSignOut alert and a forced sign-out.
AppConfiguration.resetPatient() wipes patient state, preserving only dataVersion, launchTime, launchCount and installationID.
ConsentType has cases .basic, .teleHealth(.preTest|.postTest) and .shareResults, serialised as "basic", "telehealth" and "shareResults".
ConsentUploader POSTs consent/add with type and a millisecond timestamp plus the auth token, in both Combine and async variants.
ServerAppSettings inserts a .consentUploading step between flow-configuration and completion when withBasicConsentFlow is true and basicConsent.sentToServer is not true, marking it sent on success.
AppConfiguration+PersistedSettings persists basicConsent and teleHealthConsent.
AppConfiguration lets the server's init response override the policy document URLs.
AppConfiguration+PersistedSettings declares the persisted policy URL fields privacyPolicyURL, termsAndConditionsURL, consentURL, faqURL, telehealthConsentURL and telehealthPrivacyURL.
AuthenticationCoordinator opens the policy documents from onboarding.
AppConfiguration carries the server-supplied isTelehealthConsented field.
CameraViewModel attaches MetaData(supportedObjects: [.qr(didReceive:)]) to the CameraOutput only when AppConfiguration.current.readColorboardQr is true.
ExamBuilder.parseCode(from:) splits the scanned string on the literal "c:" and requires a 6-7 character tail.
ExamBuilder writes the parsed colorboard code into exam.examDataSubObject.colorBoardId.

ExamAPI re-scans the captured frames with QRDetector.find(in:) after the local algo when qrScanningOptimizationEnabled is on and no live QR was found, reporting the outcome as the qrSeconderyExtraction analytics event.
ExamSenderService.validateColorBoardQR(for:) makes the server-side colorboard QR validation call, its path constant declared at line 386.

ExamSenderHandler maps validateColorBoardQR errors onto order statuses: .expiredKit(kitExpiration) to order .expiredKit plus AppConfiguration.current.kitExpirationDate, .usedKit to .usedKit, .flowMismatch to .flowMismatch, .noQR to .noQR, each setting exam.isValidQR = false.
ExamSenderHandler models kit validity client-side as ValidColorBoard with valid, lastUsage, maxedOut, expired and general.
LobbyViewModel treats blockFlow == .expiredKit as a pre-test block.
Alert+AdditionalObjects declares the .expiredKit alert key.

FlowCoordinator.start() branches on orderStatus(): .pendingSymptoms to symptoms, .hasSymptoms and .expiredSymptoms to the questionnaire sender, .eligibility and .pendingEligibility to eligibility, and by default DOB validation, prescription engagement or the test.
FlowCoordinator's children are eligibility, test, symptoms, results, questionnaireSender, pcp, dateOfBirth and prescription.
ChatItemsDataProvider.initialItems() and groupedItems(byName:) resolve the starting chat groups against a params dictionary, selecting conditionally between groupNames and altGroupNames.
StringProvider.string(_:_:) calls remoteString(for:) into DataManager.shared.targetDataManager.abTestingManager?.text(for:) before falling back to the bundle.
ABTestingManager.text(for:) looks up the Split.io feature string_<localizationKey>, treats the treatment control as use-the-bundle, and otherwise decodes text out of the treatment's dynamic config.
ABTestingGatekeeper whitelists which localization keys may be overridden remotely.
HLTLocalizedString.tr looks up table Localizable and retries table DefaultLocalizable when the returned value equals the key.
ChatFactory's text resolver performs the same Localizable then DefaultLocalizable two-table fallback.
ServerAppSettings sends L10n.appLanguageKey as the language in the init call.
AppCoordinator reports the device locale as analytics.
ChatFactory's resolvers load the bundled per-target chat resources.
Searched the repo for any lint rule, test or tooling enforcing reading level or a controlled vocabulary, including .danger.yml; no such check exists.

OrderData.Status mirrors the server order-status vocabulary in 28 cases, including new, client_exam_created, boundary_condition, has_results, client_timeout, client_expired_urine_sample, expired_kit, used_kit, no_qr, pending_diagnosis, client_pending_pcp and flow_mismatch.
Order encodes itself into UserDefaults under the key "flowManagerkey" and reloads through Order.loadFromMemory().
DataManager calls Order.loadFromMemory() during init.
AppCoordinator observes the HealthyPublicConstant.Notification.orderIdUpdate notification posted on order changes.
ExamSenderManager.setupExamSenderManager() re-reads the exam directory under Application Support at launch and resumes via loadIDsDic(), readAllExamsIdFromDisk() and cleanBadExams().
ExamSenderHandler persists the exam's currentStep (ExamHandlerStatus) so upload resumes mid-sequence.
HealthyFilesDataProvider.saveFileForExam writes frames per exam into <ApplicationSupport>/.../<examId>/.
HLTUserStorageDataHandler.underApplicationSupport supplies the directory root for per-exam frame storage.
ExamSenderManager deletes the exam's frames on successful upload.
ExamAPI holds prevExamsId, prevColorBoardID, prevPhotosMetaData, prevTraceFile and prevFrameToUpload.
ExamAPI.isBoundary(algoOutput:isFirstExam:) passes when validFrames >= 2, or on a second attempt when validFrames >= AppConfiguration.current.minValidFrames.
CameraViewModel.handleCancelPressed() calls builder.handleCancelledExam() and emits .didCancel.
ExamAPI.saveCancelledExam(id:) only records prevExamsId.
InstructionsChatViewModel selects .cancelCritical or .cancelNotCritical from state.isAfterDipping when the chat is dismissed.
Alert+AdditionalObjects declares the .cancelCritical and .cancelNotCritical alert keys.
AppCoordinator.resetUITime() returns 10800 s when the order is .pendingPCP and 900 s otherwise.
AppCoordinator.willMoveToForeground() resets the UI by calling resetDOBVerification(), dismissing, popping to the active child coordinator and clearing the alert.
AppCoordinator begins a background task on didEnterBackground and polls it every second until backgroundTimeRemaining is under 10.
AppConfiguration.PersistedSettings is JSON-encoded into the single UserDefaults key "AppConfiguration.PersistedSettings" through the @UserDefault wrapper.
LobbyCoordinator calls UserDataCleaner.clearAll() on every lobby entry.
DipioApp+ServiceConfigurator removes the entire UserDefaults persistent domain at launch when Natrium.Config.dataVersion differs from the stored value.
MigrateUserDefaultsToDisk runs in didFinishLaunching with an assert on failure.
GlobalTimer invalidates the Timer on didEnterBackground and, on willEnterForeground, recomputes the remaining time from startTime, then either schedules a fresh timer or reports expiry immediately.
iosDip/.natrium.yml declares the build-time constants totalTestTime and waitTime with the Dip defaults 120.0 s and 55.0 s, overridden per ACR target to 180.0 s and 70.0 s elsewhere in the file.
TestCoordinator starts the timer with totalTestTime.
ExamBuilder.canAddFrame() returns elapsedTime >= AppConfiguration.current.waitTime.
TestCoordinator builds TimerButton.Data(actualRunTime: Int(waitTime), totalDisplayTime: Int(waitTime) + 5).
InstructionsChatViewModel feeds the TimerButton chat item its Data.
InstructionsChatViewModel starts the clock via timerRunner.start() on the .dipButtonTapped event.
TestCoordinator injects a hard-coded sampleValidTime of 900 seconds.

InstructionsChatViewModel timestamps the .urineButtonTapped moment and, when the dip tap comes more than 900 s later, sets order status .expiredUrineSample and shows the .expiredUrineSample alert instead of starting the test.
TestCoordinator.timerEnded raises the .timeout alert, sets order status .timeout and opens the timeout troubleshooting chat, gated by canPresentTimeoutAlert.
CameraViewModel.timerEnded calls builder.save(timeout: true) and stops the camera.
CameraViewModel checks on appear whether the timer has already expired.
TimeoutHandler.updateOrderStatus POSTs to updateOrderStatus/<orderId>.
TargetSpecificData+MinutefulKidney sets the ACR US TimeoutExamUploadConfig to .always.
ExamAPI.handleTimeout consumes the TimeoutExamUploadConfig.
ChatFactory.makeTimingResourceResolver() force-unwraps the bubble-timing interval and asserts when a key is missing.
AppCoordinator.appSetup() sets application.isIdleTimerDisabled = true.
ExamBuilder defines three fixed shots at file scope: torch at UIDevice.current.maxTorchLevel, torch at 0.1 (0.25 for the dip10 algo), and torch off.
CameraViewModel.didCapture(processedBuffer:configuration:) holds the per-frame gating loop.
Algorithm.h declares the Objective-C protocol HLTBaseScanResult, whose Swift name is BaseScanResult.
HealthyPublicConstant.swift carries a Swift extension on HLTBaseScanResult.
ScanStatistics, a private class inside CameraViewModel.swift, keeps a 5-second sliding window of statuses per torch level and computes predominantStatus.
CameraViewModel.didProcessImage holds the corrective feedback loops.
CameraViewState.Indicator.indicatorsForPoints derives the topLeft, topRight, bottomLeft and bottomRight indicators from the algo's detected corner points.

ExamAPI.asyncRunLocalAlgoAndSendExam calls __runAlgorithm(examId, examDir, configURL, images, points, &error, shouldRunLearnedRawModel) on a .userInitiated global queue and calls fatalError on error at line 188.

BoundaryError has cases colorBoundaryThreshold, colorBoundaryCondition, colorBoundaryNormalizer, focusError, missingOrBadStick, stickReflections, shadowBoundaryCondition, stickShadow, cannotExtractStick, cannotValidateStick, suspectedStickFaceDown and other.
Alert+AdditionalObjects declares the boundary alert keys .boundaryMissingOrMisplaced, .boundaryLight, .shadow, .boundaryOther, .focus, .colorNormalizer and .stickReflections.
ExamBuilder.saveFrame(image:at:) writes each frame asynchronously as PNG when AppConfiguration.current.sendPngImages is set and otherwise as JPEG at quality 1.0.
TestCoordinator enables the learned-RAW model only when the server flag localLearnedRawEnabled and the Split.io flag exam_algo_learnedRaw are both on.
CameraManager defaults its session preset to AVCaptureSession.Preset.hd1920x1080.
CameraManager uses a dedicated session queue and a dedicated output queue.
CameraViewModel selects the lens as .back(type: .wideAngle).
FrameSettings carries torchLevel, wbGains (.continues or .update(new:)) and exposure (.continues or .adjust(byMultiplier:)), applied through CameraManager.apply(settings:).
CameraViewModel calls CameraManager.apply(settings:) per frame.
CameraViewModel converts CameraError.failToUpdateTorchMode and .torchLevelUpdateFailure into the torchIssueMismatch and unableToTurnOnTorch analytics events.
CameraViewModel waits 0.15 s for torch spin-up before frames are accepted.
CameraManager.currentWhiteBalanceGains() reports red, green and blue gains, maxSupportedGain and whether device.whiteBalanceMode is .locked.
CameraViewModel gates whether manual white balance is offered to the algo on the server flag manualWhiteBalanceEnabled.
CameraManager returns a non-nil customExposureDuration only when device.exposureMode is .custom.
CameraViewModel passes cameraManager.customExposureDuration as the exposureTime argument of ExamBuilder.addFrame.
Searched CameraManager in the ios-camera HLTCameraModule package for an explicit focus-lock call; none exists.
CameraViewModel initialises CameraManagerConfiguration with .init(withGlobalToneMappingFlag: appConfiguration.withGlobalToneMappingFlag).
ExamBuilder.save() calls exam.updateManuallyDisablesLocalToneMappingFlag() to record whether local tone mapping was manually disabled.
The ACR camera path configures rawConfiguration: .disabled.
CameraManager.metadataOutput(...) handles the AVCaptureMetadataOutput QR objects.
NetworkManager routes retry and completion handling through SessionHelper.RetryHandler.
DataManager implements the didProcess and didFinish delegate hooks to feed the logger.
DataManager constructs the PlatformInfo whose description becomes the device-details header.
AppConfiguration exposes serverURL, authURL and umURL, resolved per environment by ServerEnvironment.info.
ExamSenderHandler declares ExamHandlerStatus with 14 cases and SendOrder with 5 orderings.
TargetSpecificData+MinutefulKidney sets ACR to SendOrder.results.
ExamSenderHandler defines the results ordering as notStarted, sendExam, uploadTrace, validateColorboardQR, getResults, getNextFlow, userStepsEnded, uploadFrames, runEnded.
